page: Amazon Web Services g5g.8xlarge is an accelerated computing instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, integrating arm64 Graviton processing with dedicated GPU acceleration. The instance configuration includes 32 dedicated AWS Graviton Neoverse-N1 physical cores operating at 2.5 GHz, providing a single thread per core without hyperthreading. System memory totals 64.0 GB, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core. Graphic and compute acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA T4G GPU based on the Turing architecture, offering 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance does not include bundled local storage, relying on external network-attached storage options, and maintains a baseline network throughput of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark data reflects the execution profile of 32 physical arm64 cores paired with the T4G accelerator. Multi-core performance remains stable in average tiers, demonstrated by a stress-ng multi-core result of 48574.86, a Geekbench multi-core score of 11551.0, and 25518.0 in Clang software compilation. Conversely, single-thread metrics fall in lower percentiles, with Geekbench single-core reaching 952.0 and single-threaded gzip compression recording 20.17 GB/sec. Memory subsystem evaluation indicates moderate uncached transfer speeds, delivering 161.7 GB/sec read and 72.88 GB/sec write. In language model inference testing, the instance achieved 31.98 tokens per second during prompt processing and 15.24 tokens per second during text generation on a 7B parameter model.

The architecture presents distinct cost-efficiency advantages by pairing power-efficient Graviton execution units with a specialized T4G accelerator. While single-threaded tasks and large-scale model serving encounter architectural limits, the system provides high density for parallel graphics rendering and native arm64 application scaling. Primary workload targets include Android mobile gaming streaming, media transcode pipelines, automated continuous integration for arm64 builds, and lightweight model inference.
description: Amazon Web Services g5g.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated, arm64-based cloud instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. The host provides 32 dedicated AWS Graviton Neoverse-N1 cores clocked at 2.5 GHz, paired with 64 GB of system RAM, offering 2 GB of memory per core. Acceleration is delivered via a single NVIDIA T4G GPU equipped with 16 GB of video memory based on the Turing architecture. Network connectivity operates at a baseline throughput of 12 Gbps, while local disk storage is not bundled, necessitating network-attached storage for persistent data. In benchmark evaluations, multi-core throughput and compiling metrics perform consistently within median brackets, though single-threaded performance registers in lower percentiles. The combination of power-efficient Graviton silicon and dedicated GPU hardware delivers qualitative resource efficiency for target workloads. The g5g.8xlarge is specifically designed for arm64 native workloads, Android game streaming, media encoding, and medium-scale machine learning inference.
